product_launches.description: AMEA Power has successfully commissioned a 500MW wind power plant in Ras Ghareb, Egypt, now the largest operational wind farm in Africa. The facility is expected to generate 2,500 GWh of clean electricity annually, powering over 500,000 homes and offsetting 1.4 million tons of CO₂ emissions each year. The project was completed ahead of schedule and involved significant local employment and community engagement.

overview_description.description: AMEA Power develops, owns, and operates utility-scale solar and battery energy storage projects across Africa, the Middle East, and Asia. The company constructs photovoltaic plants and hybrid systems and negotiates long-term power purchase agreements to supply clean electricity. Its portfolio includes operational, under-construction, and planned projects ranging from 24 MW solar farms in Uganda to 500 MW solar plants in Egypt, often integrating battery storage to enhance grid stability. AMEA Power also partners with governments and industry to secure financing and concessions for its energy developments, contributing to regional infrastructure expansion in renewable power.
